legalNotice.text: The cartridge boxes are for organising and sorting. They do not replace a lockable container or gun safe as required by Section 36 of the German Weapons Act (WaffG) for storing ammunition.
legalNotice.short: For order inside your gun safe – not a substitute for legally required storage (§ 36 WaffG).
